sections.advice: Scenic stretch near Petershausen → Photo stop near Au in der Hallertau is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

sections.from: Photo stop near Au in der Hallertau

Food stop near Bad Feilnbach → Back to Grossglockner is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.
